lean.statement:
{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (W : E → ℝ) (hW : ContDiff ℝ 2 W)
    (hI : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (-W x)))
    (hZ : 0 < ∫ x, Real.exp (-W x))
    (m M : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hmM : m ≤ M)
    (hlower : ∀ x a, m*‖a‖^2 ≤ fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ W) x a a)
    (hupper : ∀ x a, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ W) x a a ≤ M*‖a‖^2) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -W x)
    ∀ f : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 f → MemLp f 2 μ → MemLp (gradient f) 2 μ →
      AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.Poincare.Admissible μ f ∧
      m*AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.Poincare.variance μ f ≤
        AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.Poincare.dirichletEnergy μ f
approved_definition_context: Actual original compact-smooth weighted-gradient closure, finite-dimensional real Hilbert/Borel fullspace including0. BOTH C2 m/M curvature, exp(-W) integrability/positive partition explicit in canonical nodes; not full lower-only source D6.

Same-D/epsilon/forcing actual variational witnesses are identified by genuine uniqueness before transferring global gradient bound; strong scaled residual tested against centered z proves Poincare after zero-norm split. No supplied Poincare/coercivity/limit certificate or centered/unscaled resolvent/epsilon0 premise.
Actual C1 scalar+gradientL2 centering produces original graph pair; derive real Admissible integrability and AE L2 norm/variance/Dirichlet identities.

Source C2 alpha-beta eta cap actual commonJRS/reflected W_y/positive partitions/originalD beforeALLcentered z/score a. Exact quarter m_y=(alpha+eta^-1)/4, M_y=(beta+eta^-1)/4 and unnormalized PARAMETER-y score variance constant (eta^-1-alpha)^2/[4*(alpha+eta^-1)].

R/S existential common-law witnesses, not project-owned canonical chosen definitions. Auxiliary versions only pointwise formulas/literal density equality; no R2=R/alternateD/jointselector. No normalized score differentiation, marginal Poincare, anisotropicBL/main/composition; TV nevertransfers unboundedcost.

Exact existing compiled API definitions (same actual measure; no energy prefactor):
noncomputable def variance (μ : Measure E) (f : E → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x, (f x - ∫ y, f y ∂μ) ^ 2 ∂μ

noncomputable def dirichletEnergy (μ : Measure E) (f : E → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x, ‖gradient f x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ

def Admissible (μ : Measure E) (f : E → ℝ) : Prop :=
  Integrable f μ ∧
    Integrable (fun x => (f x - ∫ y, f y ∂μ) ^ 2) μ ∧
    Integrable (fun x => ‖gradient f x‖ ^ 2) μ
Exact real Hilbert gradient: gradient f x = (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E).symm (fderiv ℝ f x). This is the actual Riesz representative; C1 assumptions ensure genuine derivatives in the public consumers.
